description: The case that matters most: the harness reports success and the Brain overrules it. One criterion really passes and one really fails when run against the worktree, so the task ends failed even though the session outcome was accepted. This is BR-2 in executable form (verification is never delegated to the harness that did the work); if this case ever flips to succeeded, the Brain has started trusting harness self-reports.
